data.title: 加藤惠 · 假日晨光的大号衬衫柔情
data.description: 难得留宿的早晨，惠套着男式大号白衬衫跨坐在你腰间。衬衫扣子解开了大半，露出纤细白皙的锁骨与软肉，平时波澜不惊的眼神在微喘中漾起轻微水光——「伦也君……别光看着啊。要是社团脚本写不出来的话……这种取材……稍微、再多陪你一下也可以哦。」
data.action: 身穿半敞的宽大衬衫跪坐在画外同行者腰间，垂眸前倾，露出羞涩的浅笑。
data.lighting: 柔和暖光与唯美阴影交错
data.promptProse: Seen from a low first-person angle across rumpled morning bedding washed in warm window sunlight, Megumi sits astride her partner and leans down slightly with a quiet, shy smile and faintly misted eyes.
data.nsfwProse: Her oversized white men's dress shirt is unbuttoned down the front to expose her bare breasts, collarbones, and upper thighs as she straddles him.
data.animaCaption: Kneeling astride her partner's waist on the sunlit morning bedsheets in an unbuttoned oversized white dress shirt falling open off her bare chest, she leans close with a soft shy smile and lightly flushed cheeks.
